subject: Post-call recap: OliveTech trial — stakeholder responsibilities, sprint card & success metrics
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Priya Kapoor <priya.kapoor@olivetech.com>, Mark Ellis <mark@olivetech.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 22 Jan 2027 15:03:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call recap: OliveTech trial — stakeholder responsibilities, sprint card & success metrics

Hi Priya / Mark — great call today, thanks for the time. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a single reference for owners and timelines. I’ve kept this intentionally tight and put items that need decisions at the top.

1) Success criteria (trial acceptance) — to confirm
   - 95th pctl latency under 350ms for the standard 512-token prompt set (OliveProdPrompts v1.0)
   - End-to-end cost per 1k inference tokens at or below $X (we'll provide profiling)
   - Quality: rate of unacceptable responses < 3% on your seeded eval set (we discussed 120 prompt checks)

2) Runbook / evaluation plan highlights
   - Week 0 (kickoff): infra handshake, credentials, and test dataset upload
   - Week 1: smoke tests + latency/cost baseline
   - Week 2–3: workload ramp & quality checks (seeded prompts)
   - Week 4: acceptance review and decision window

3) Proposed ownership (first pass) — please confirm or correct by EOD Monday
   - Olive infra lead (networking, VPC peering, firewall rules): OliveTech (Priya)
   - Redwood infra onboarding (service endpoints, access tokens, routing): Ben Carter (Redwood)
   - App integration owner (API wiring, rate limiting tests): Mark (OliveTech) and Karthik (Redwood SE) — joint owners
   - Security/compliance contact (data retention, logs): Priya (OliveTech) + Redwood security contact if needed (we will loop in SRE/Auth)
   - Procurement/PO timeline: Priya noted procurement window below

4) Decisions we need from OliveTech
   - Confirmation of who will approve the acceptance criteria above (name + role)
   - Desired start date for Week 0 (we proposed Mon 2027-02-01)

5) Attachments included in this thread
   - sprintcard_olivetech.xlsx (proposed sprint card with milestones and owners)
   - olive_infra_sketch.png (hand-sketch of network handoff points)

Next steps I’ll take: Ben will prepare the onboarding checklist and a lightweight infra diagram; Karthik will draft the SE test script. I’ll publish the sprint card and link it to the HubSpot deal. Please reply with any edits to owners or the acceptance criteria.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0133

Subject: Re: Post-call recap: OliveTech trial — stakeholder responsibilities, sprint card & success metrics

Thanks Vanessa — this is very helpful and aligned with what we discussed. A few quick notes from procurement/security side: 

- Procurement timeline: target to issue PO in the week of Feb 8 (internal approvals currently in flight). If Redwood needs a commitment earlier for Reserved capacity, flag that and we’ll prioritize.
- Security owner: I’ll assign Ravi Shah (IT Security Manager) as our point for logs/retention and the SOC questionnaire. He’s copied once I confirm his calendar next week (I’ll loop him in by Tuesday).
- Acceptance approver: Mark Ellis (CTO) will be the final sign-off for trial acceptance.

We can start Week 0 on Feb 1 for the initial handshake as proposed — I’ll confirm my team’s availability Monday.

Also attaching our internal list of seeded prompts for the seeded-eval (brief excerpt below).

Adding a few infra notes and clarifications based on the call and Priya’s reply: 

- Redwood onboarding tasks (Ben)
  * Create a short-lived onboarding token + service account for OliveTech (scoped to test env)
  * Provide sample curl/postman scripts for the standard 512-token prompts
  * Turn on prefix/KV caching in the test environment to match expected app behavior (we’ll document metrics)

- Network/infra sketch: olive_infra_sketch.png attached — shows where VPC peering vs. public endpoints are recommended. If Olive wants private link we'll catalogue the steps and estimate timeline (usually +3 business days).

- RACI (proposed sprintcard column) — quick defaults I added: 
  * Infra setup: R=OliveTech (Priya) / A=Ben / C=Karthik / I=Vanessa
  * App integration test: R=Mark / A=Karthik / C=Ben / I=Priya
  * Security questionnaire: R=Priya / A=Ravi Shah (when looped) / C=Ben / I=Vanessa
Please take a look at the sprintcard and tell me if you want different accountability tags. I’ll also include the minimal test payloads in the Drive doc.
